owner: providers openai_chat_completions usage.cost parse to the provider_response and provider_turn_duration events
synthetic_source: Every usage object in fixtures/events.json is hand-authored for Issue #947; none is copied from a provider response, a benchmark task, a grader input, an expected answer, generated code, or a run record. The amount 0.012345 matches the value the S-175a host check sent to a local fake HTTP stand-in; nothing else is taken from that record.
base_events: fixtures/events.json base_events holds, for each case and for the executor and planner paths, the provider_response and provider_turn_duration lines that commit base_sha wrote when src/providers/lm_studio.rs billed_cost_telemetry_tests replayed the case from a loopback OpenAI-compatible stand-in with no credentials; only the wall-clock duration_ms value is replaced with 0. An unreported amount must leave these lines byte-identical; a reported one may only add provider_billed_cost_usd.
aggregation: count provider_billed_cost_usd once per turn; provider_response and provider_turn_duration of one turn carry the same amount and are never added together
